# Specialty worked examples

> Companion to the [Specialty authoring guide](specialties.md): annotated manifest excerpts and the shipped `specialist` type.

## Worked examples

Each surface below is pulled directly from the live coding-agent manifest, [`specialties/coding/manifest.yaml`](https://github.com/app-vitals/shipwright/blob/main/specialties/coding/manifest.yaml) in app-vitals/shipwright — the reference type shipped with Shipwright itself (it is not part of this repository). Use it as a second, fuller reference alongside the [blank template](specialties.md#blank-template).

### Crons

A pipeline-phase cron dispatched by a parent orchestrator cron, plus a standalone maintenance cron:

```yaml
crons:
  - name: shipwright-dev-task
    schedule: "* * * * *"
    prompt: /shipwright:dev-task
    silent: true
    enabled: true
    parentCron: shipwright-loop
  - name: shipwright-docs-freshness
    schedule: "0 7 * * *"
    prompt: /shipwright:research-docs --auto
    preCheck: shipwright:check-docs-freshness.ts
    silent: true
    enabled: false
```

`shipwright-dev-task` is a phase dispatched by `shipwright-loop` (its `parentCron`), so it doesn't need its own `preCheck` — the orchestrator handles candidate selection. `shipwright-docs-freshness` is a standalone scheduled scan with a `preCheck` gate and ships `enabled: false` (see [crons ship disabled](specialties.md#new-crons-in-published-types-ship-enabled-false)).

### Env contract

One required secret, one optional secret, one optional non-secret:

```yaml
env:
  required:
    - key: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
      description: >-
        Claude Code OAuth token used to authenticate the agent's Claude
        sessions (alternative to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
      secret: true
  optional:
    - key: GH_TOKEN
      description: >-
        GitHub Personal Access Token, used as a fallback for GitHub API
        access when GitHub App credentials are not configured.
      secret: true
    - key: PIPER_VOICE
      description: >-
        Piper voice name to use for local (offline) speech synthesis when
        no cloud voice provider is configured.
      secret: false
```

Note there is no `value:` anywhere — see [manifests never contain secret values](specialties.md#manifests-never-contain-secret-values).

### Plugins

```yaml
plugins:
  - shipwright
```

A list of Claude Code plugin package names to install for agents of this type. The coding type installs exactly the `shipwright` plugin itself.

### Members

```yaml
members: []
```

Default member list for agents provisioned from this type — usually empty (`[]`) in the manifest itself, with actual members added per-agent-instance after provisioning via the admin API (`AgentMember` rows), not baked into the shared type manifest.

### Tools

```yaml
tools:
  - Read
  - Write
  - Edit
  - Glob
  - Grep
  - Bash
  - WebSearch
  - WebFetch
  - Skill
  - Agent
  - Monitor
```

This list is **additive on top of the floor set** — see [FLOOR_TOOLS are outside manifest authority](specialties.md#floor_tools-are-outside-manifest-authority). Listing `Read`/`Write`/`Edit`/`Glob`/`Grep`/`Skill` here is harmless (they're already floor-granted) but redundant; the fields that actually matter to declare are the high-privilege ones — `Bash`, `WebSearch`, `WebFetch`, `Agent`, `Monitor` — since those are never floor-granted.

### Repos

```yaml
repos: []
```

Default `org/repo`-formatted repos for agents of this type — like `members`, usually empty in the shared type manifest, with real repos assigned per-agent-instance after provisioning.

## Specialist type

`agent-types/specialist/manifest.yaml` is a generic, non-coding Specialty for agents that are not delivery agents. It uses existing manifest fields only — no schema or loader changes — and appears in the new-specialty picker automatically via `listTypes()`.

It differs from `coding` in what it does *not* grant: `crons: []` (no system crons — `learn-dream` is excluded because it needs the `shipwright` plugin), `plugins: []` (no `shipwright` plugin), `repos: []` and `GH_TOKEN` optional only (no GitHub or task-store scope), and a smaller additive tool set (`Bash`, `WebSearch`, `WebFetch`, `Agent` on top of the floor tools; no `Monitor`). The env contract is otherwise the same as `coding`.

Specialties layer their own plugins, crons and env on top after creation, via the admin API.

**Workspace templates:** `identity.templatesDir` points at `agent-types/specialist/templates/`, which provides the persona templates (`CLAUDE.md`, `SOUL.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, all `*.template`) with no coding-only sections, plus an optional `SPECIALTY.md.template`. Files the directory omits (`VOICE.md`, `mise.toml`, `requirements.txt`, `BOOTSTRAP.md`) fall back per file to `runtime/workspace/`; the three persona templates are required or the type falls back to `runtime/workspace/` entirely.
